description: CHECK constraints are ENFORCED (unlike PK/UNIQUE/FK): INSERT, UPDATE and MERGE refuse rows the check makes FALSE while NULL passes (three-valued logic); DESCRIBE's check cell belongs to the ONE column the expression names (two-column checks appear nowhere, the later check wins a shared cell); GET_DDL renders every check as a table-level line; adding one later demands ENABLE NOVALIDATE and leaves existing rows alone; unnamed checks report under their generated SYS_CONSTRAINT name; CHECK is reserved as a name while NOVALIDATE is not. All live-verified. Converted 1:1 from ddl/CheckConstraintTest (now retired).
